name: Age and birthdays
description: Age from a birth date, and days until the next birthday.
solve: function solve(q,ctx){const M='jan feb mar apr may jun jul aug sep oct nov dec'.split(' ');const now=new Date(ctx&&ctx.now||Date.now());const t=q.toLowerCase().replace(/(\d)(st|nd|rd|th)\b/g,'$1');let d=null;let m=t.match(/(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})/);if(m)d=new Date(+m[1],+m[2]-1,+m[3]);if(!d&&(m=t.match(/\b(jan|feb|mar|apr|may|jun|jul|aug|sep|oct|nov|dec)[a-z]*\.?\s+(\d{1,2}),?\s+(\d{4})/)))d=new Date(+m[3],M.indexOf(m[1]),+m[2]);if(!d&&(m=t.match(/\b(\d{1,2})\s+(jan|feb|mar|apr|may|jun|jul|aug|sep|oct|nov|dec)[a-z]*\s+(\d{4})/)))d=new Date(+m[3],M.indexOf(m[2]),+m[1]);if(!d&&(m=t.match(/\b(19\d{2}|20\d{2})\b/)))d=new Date(+m[1],0,1);if(!d)return{answer:null,reason:'Give a birth date.'};let y=now.getFullYear()-d.getFullYear();const had=now.getMonth()>d.getMonth()||now.getMonth()===d.getMonth()&&now.getDate()>=d.getDate();if(!had)y--;let next=new Date(now.getFullYear(),d.getMonth(),d.getDate());if(next<new Date(now.getFullYear(),now.getMonth(),now.getDate()))next.setFullYear(now.getFullYear()+1);const days=Math.round((next-new Date(now.getFullYear(),now.getMonth(),now.getDate()))/864e5);const onlyYear=!/\d{1,2}\s|-\d{2}-|[a-z]\s+\d{1,2}/.test(t.replace(/\b(19|20)\d{2}\b/,''));return{answer:onlyYear?`${y-1} or ${y} years old`:`${y} years old${days?`, next birthday in ${days} days`:' — happy birthday'}`,steps:[`Born ${d.toDateString()}`,`Today ${now.toDateString()}`]}}
